name: Echogarden
role: Node speech toolkit: forced alignment of a known transcript, TTS, recognition; writes SRT/VTT/JSON
notes: 2026-11-27: lead (prospects/inbox/2026-11-24-discovery.md) said MIT AND GPL-3.0 and v3.4.0; npm 3.4.0 confirms both, and the package ships LICENSE.MIT.md and LICENSE.GPLv3.md.

2026-11-27: align() with engine dtw needs no model download (espeak-ng WASM synthesises a reference and DTW matches MFCCs); the Whisper-guided and other engines fetch models at run time and were not run.

2026-11-27: fixture examples/echogarden-forced-alignment is PARTIAL: word order and monotonic timings pass; 8 of 10 starts within 0.20 s (needed 9) and rerun timings differ for 3 words, both KNOWN FAIL.

evidence.result: DTW forced alignment of a known 10-word transcript to macOS say speech with silence gaps: words in reference order, starts non-decreasing (pass). KNOWN FAIL: 8/10 starts within 0.20 s of known onsets (gate 9), mean error 0.14 s, max 0.68 s; in-process rerun differs for brown, river, today (gate: identical). No model download. Node 22.19.0.
evidence.scope: DTW engine only, one generated sentence with 0.4 s gaps, macOS arm64. Fails the 9/10 start bound and rerun identity. Not Whisper-guided alignment, other engines, real speech.

summary: Node CLI and library for speech: forced alignment of a known transcript to audio (DTW against espeak-synthesised speech, or Whisper-guided), text-to-speech, recognition and translation, with SRT, VTT and JSON timelines. Runs from pnpm with no Python; the DTW engine needs no model download, other engines fetch models at run time with their own licences.
use_when: Need word timings for a known transcript from Node, with no Python environment
Need caption files (SRT/VTT) written directly from alignment
avoid_when: Audio has long pauses and DTW word starts must be tight: the fixture missed by up to 0.68 s; use whisperx
Need mouth-shape cues rather than word times: use rhubarb-lip-sync
license: MIT AND GPL-3.0 (npm package); downloaded engines and models carry separate, unverified terms

assessment.rationale: Free software (MIT and GPL-3.0 in one package); v3.4.0 on npm 2026-09-08. Only Node-native aligner among the neighbours. DTW engine ran with no download but missed two predeclared checks on a gapped sentence.
